note: Draft for the product owner's review. Each class has one accounting meaning; codes describe the meaning and never copy a source system's code; company, currency, channel and similar differences are account-assignment conditions, not classes. A configuration may not be validated against a class that is not APPROVED.

classes.name: Policy receivable
classes.definition: Premium, tax and levies a policyholder owes once a policy transaction is written, before it is invoiced.

classes.name: Invoice receivable
classes.definition: Amounts invoiced to a policyholder and not yet paid.

classes.name: Fee receivable
classes.definition: Fees and charges (membership, instalment, administration) owed and not yet paid.

classes.name: Collections held by agents
classes.definition: Money a collection agent or payment provider collected for the insurer and has not yet remitted.

classes.name: Recoveries receivable
classes.definition: Estimated salvage and third-party recoveries not yet received.

classes.name: Tax recoverable
classes.definition: Input tax the insurer can reclaim on claims and expenses (for example GST input tax credits).

classes.name: Reinsurance receivable
classes.definition: Amounts due from reinsurers on paid claims.

classes.name: Intercompany receivable
classes.definition: Amounts due from another company of the same group.

classes.name: Cash at bank
classes.definition: Money in the insurer's bank accounts; the account is chosen by company, currency and channel.

classes.name: Unallocated cash
classes.definition: Money received but not yet matched to a receivable (suspense).

classes.name: Tax payable
classes.definition: Indirect tax (GST, VAT, IPT) collected on premium and fees, owed to the tax authority.

classes.name: Levies and duties payable
classes.definition: Statutory levies and duties collected with premium (for example fire service levy, stamp duty).

classes.name: Refunds payable
classes.definition: Money owed back to policyholders (cancellations, overpayments) and not yet paid.

classes.name: Commission payable
classes.definition: Commission owed to brokers and agents.

classes.name: Claims payable
classes.definition: Claim payments approved but not yet paid out.

classes.name: Reinsurance payable
classes.definition: Premium owed to reinsurers.

classes.name: Intercompany payable
classes.definition: Amounts due to another company of the same group.

classes.name: Other payables
classes.definition: Other amounts owed, including small unapplied amounts written off but still owed.

classes.name: Unearned premium reserve
classes.definition: Premium written for cover not yet provided at the reporting date.

classes.name: Outstanding claims reserve
classes.definition: Estimated cost of reported claims not yet paid (case reserves).

classes.name: Gross premium written
classes.definition: Premium of policies written, before reinsurance.

classes.name: Movement in unearned premium
classes.definition: Change in the unearned premium reserve, shown against premium.

classes.name: Fee income
classes.definition: Policy, membership and instalment fees charged.

classes.name: Recoveries received
classes.definition: Salvage and third-party recoveries received on claims.

classes.name: Movement in recoveries receivable
classes.definition: Change in estimated recoveries receivable.

classes.name: Excess received
classes.definition: Policy excess (deductible) collected from claimants.

classes.name: Gross claims paid
classes.definition: Claim amounts paid, excluding recoverable tax.

classes.name: Movement in outstanding claims
classes.definition: Change in the outstanding claims reserve.

classes.name: Commission expense
classes.definition: Commission earned by brokers and agents.

classes.name: Reinsurance premium ceded
classes.definition: Premium ceded to reinsurers.

classes.name: Bad debt write-off
classes.definition: Receivables written off as uncollectable.
